messages:
maya: hey team — nightly eval CI failing intermittently since the quant-quantize merge, looks like shard workers are hitting queue backpressure and then we get duplicate counts in the metrics. job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/runs/38291 :frowning:

akshay: can you paste the runner logs? is it OOM or 503s?

maya: paste below. mostly 503 / RPC errors, then the runner retries and we count the same sample twice.

maya: ```
2026-01-29T03:21:12Z runner[shard=21] ERROR: enqueue task failed: queue_full (capacity=4096)
2026-01-29T03:21:12Z runner[shard=21] WARN: rpc call to worker-17:503 ServiceUnavailable
2026-01-29T03:21:12Z runner[shard=21] INFO: retrying (attempt=1) id=sample-3f9a
2026-01-29T03:21:13Z eval-collector INFO: recorded sample id=sample-3f9a status=completed
2026-01-29T03:21:13Z eval-collector INFO: recorded sample id=sample-3f9a status=completed
```

tara: that double-recording is probably from the collector treating retries as new completions. We need idempotency keys on the collector side. Also I think the quantized model increased per-inference latency, so queues fill faster.

akshay: +1 on idempotency. Two parts: (1) dedupe at collector by sample_id, (2) make runner retries attach the same request_id or return a duplicate flag. Also reduce default shard count in CI so we don't oversubscribe the small runners.

julian: SRE alerted on CPU spikes for the eval-runners around the same window: https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/ops/eval-runner?panel=3

ci-bot: Job 38291 failed: exit=1 (shard 21 queue_full). Re-run: https://ci.redwood.ai/retry/38291

maya: here's our current runner config in CI (small instance):
```yaml
runner:
  shards: 32
  max_workers_per_shard: 2
  queue_capacity: 4096
  retry_policy:
    max_attempts: 3
    backoff_ms: 100
```

maya: thinking of trying: shards=8, max_workers_per_shard=1, queue_capacity=8192, and exponential jitter on retry.

akshay: try that as a quick CI hotfix. longer term: add dedupe metric and fix collector idempotency. For metrics, we should stop relying on "completed_count" only — introduce "unique_samples_completed" and a tag retry=true/false.

tara: also add a per-shard queue_depth gauge to the eval dashboard and an alert when queue_depth > 75% for > 2m. That will catch backpressure earlier.

maya: agree. I'll push a hotfix PR to CI with shards=8 and the backoff change, and run a canary on the quantized model only.

akshay: I'll open the dedupe PR for the collector. Plan: if collector sees sample_id already recorded, return HTTP 200 with body {"duplicate":true} and emit metric "eval.sample_duplicate" with tag model=<model>.

julian: I'll add the queue_depth panel + a small alert rule in the dashboard repo.

maya: eval-bot shows a rerun started (canary). eval-bot: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/runs/38292

eval-bot: Run 38292 (canary) started: shards=8, workers=1, model=quant-v2-small

sre-bot: note: node worker-17 had IO wait spikes at 03:20:45, might be noisy neighbor on the host. Recommend pinning runners to less-busy hosts for CI canaries.

tara: good catch. we'll schedule the canary on a dedicated host pool.

maya: next steps summarized:
- maya: hotfix CI config (shards=8, backoff jitter) and run canary (in progress)
- akshay: collector dedupe PR + metric (ETA today)
- julian: dashboard panel + alert (ETA today)
- tara: run canary on dedicated hostpool + run a 2h smoke test on quantized model (ETA tomorrow)

maya: any objections? :thumbsup: for the plan?

akshay: :thumbsup:

julian: :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks everyone — will update thread when canary finishes.
